content: Official mypyc docs say native classes restrict attributes, dataclasses have partial native support, and primitive tuple/union types are supported. A local compile-and-run probe with project-pinned mypyc 1.17.1 verified a frozen slotted dataclass group containing a tuple of slotted entries and a dict value union of entry/group compiles, has no instance dict, rejects group field reassignment, and dispatches through isinstance.
